command: set -u; if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo GH_PRESENT=1; if gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo GH_AUTH=1; else echo GH_AUTH=0; fi; else echo GH_PRESENT=0; fi; if git ls-remote git@github.com:gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git HEAD >/tmp/omega_world_lsremote.out 2>/tmp/omega_world_lsremote.err; then echo SSH_FRANKENSTEIN_ACCESS=1; cat /tmp/omega_world_lsremote.out; else echo SSH_FRANKENSTEIN_ACCESS=0; tail -20 /tmp/omega_world_lsremote.err; fi
